data.body: Landing-order note (epic task-dag advisory): children 985c (graph complexity) and b2bb (compact split) both update the GENERATED ratchet file .github/complexity-baseline.json, since each lowers CCN baselines. This is not a semantic conflict — the baseline is regenerated by re-running the baseline command, and Gerrit Rebase-If-Necessary re-derives it on the second change to land. Guidance: whichever lands second must re-run the complexity-baseline regeneration before/at rebase so its entry reflects post-first-change numbers; no explicit blocking edge is added (it would only serialize a mechanically-regenerated file). All other child file_impacts are disjoint.
